tricks: HOOK (Q1): 0:00-0:12 = 4 FULL film shots (Grace Kelly-like, Breakfast at Tiffany's, Scent of a Woman-like ballroom, wide restaurant), ~3-4 s each, dissolves; no text in the hook except the CA watermark. Title appears at 0:13 (13 s in) as 'Episode 14' + 'How to Speak Elegantly' script written on over a B&W Audrey clip, held across one dissolve to a colour actress, then fade to white at 0:21 straight into card 1.

POINT OPENING (Q2): every point = fade to plain white -> black script '<n>. <Title>' written on left to right, 3-4 s, voice reads the title (0:22, 1:26, 2:18, 3:47, 4:51, 6:01). Right before the card: a quote card or fade-to-white (2:13-2:17 quote cross-fades into card 3; 3:42 caramel quote -> white -> card 4; 5:56 quote -> white -> card 6). Right after the card: dissolve to an empty caramel beat (0:26, 3:51) or straight to a FULL film clip (1:29, 2:22, 4:55, 6:05).

POINT CLOSING (Q2): points end on a summary quote card typed in sync with the voice: 1:20-1:25 ('You'll notice the difference immediately'), 2:13-2:17 ('Soft voices don't scream...'), 3:42-3:45 ('Less noise, more intention...'), 4:44-4:50 ('Elegant texting isn't about being perfect...'), 5:56-5:59 ('Elegance isn't only in the way you speak...'), 6:51-6:57 ('These little shifts...').

CLIP HOLDS (Q3): FULL clips 2-4 s (e.g. 0:45-0:48, 1:35-1:38, 2:06-2:09); hard-cut dialogue triplets ~1 s each (0:40/0:41/0:42, 4:55/4:57/4:58); centred single clips 3-6 s (Grace Kelly 2:31-2:36 = 5.5 s; Diana interview 1:48-1:54 = 7 s with her voice); quote cards 4-8 s (2:52-2:59 = 8 s); DON'T/DO picture+text slides 5-6 s each (3:09-3:15, 3:15-3:21, 3:22-3:27).

FILM/REAL AUDIO MOMENTS: the narration stops and the source audio is heard twice: Breakfast at Tiffany's dialogue 0:33-0:39 (~6 s) right after naming Audrey Hepburn, and Princess Diana's own interview voice 1:48-1:54 (~7 s) right after naming Diana. Both are louder than the narration (peaks ~-14 dB).

ROWS (Q4): always 3 panels, separated by thin caramel gaps, filling the frame height. Built one panel at a time ~0.5-1 s apart: grow-in (Audrey 0:27-0:29), drop in from the top (1:07-1:10, on 'calm / thoughtful / in control' - one woman per adjective), left-to-right fade/slide (3:52-3:54, 5:28-5:30, 6:10-6:13). Variant: a centred clip first, then two side panels slide in from the screen edges together (Kate 1:56-1:58; panel talk 2:37-2:39). Rows are either ONE named woman in 3 photos (Audrey 0:27, Diana 1:40, Kate 1:57) or 3 DIFFERENT women doing the same thing (texting 3:52 incl. a silver-haired older woman; socialising 5:28; office talk 6:10 incl. a plus-size woman).

NAMED WOMEN (Q6): Audrey Hepburn (named 0:28) -> 3 B&W photos in a row, then a Breakfast at Tiffany's clip with sound, then Sabrina clips; Princess Diana (named 1:40) -> 3-photo row, then centred vertical news clips, then her interview with her own voice (1:40-1:54, ~15 s in total). Other celebrities (Amal Clooney, Emma Watson, Kate, Grace Kelly, Angelina Jolie, Demi Moore-like, Margot Robbie-like) appear unnamed as mood footage. No name labels ever appear on screen.

DO/DON'T (Q7): never red/green marks or crosses. Done as (a) picture rounded on the left + the DON'T phrase in plain serif in quote marks on the right, then the DO phrase in larger script under it 1-2 s later (3:09, 3:15, 3:34, 5:21-5:26, 5:35, 6:32); (b) DO phrase alone in script under/next to a picture (3:22, 5:44); (c) chat bubbles on stock clips with the DON'T bubble swapped for the DO bubble (4:18-4:19 'I don't know lol' -> 'I'm not sure, let me check.'; '...' x5 -> 'Hold on, give me a sec'); (d) caption swap on a FULL clip (6:44-6:46 'Oh no it's nothing.' -> 'Thank you, that's kind of you.').

GUIDE MENTION (Q8): mid-video at 2:43-2:51 (about 34% in), inside point 3, introduced with 'By the way'. Picture: a FULL creator fashion reel then a CREAM-framed vertical before/after outfit reel (whose own 'Me before... / Vs. after learning what flatters me.' captions stay). NO channel text on screen. Audio: a ~0.3 s near-silent gap at 2:43.4 before 'By the way' and the voice in this block is louder (-13 to -16 dB peaks) - it sounds like a dropped-in, separately recorded block.

OUTRO MENTION + ASK (Q8): 6:58-7:09 'Be sure to check the description for elegant clothing links and access to the personal stylist guide...' with centred text 'Check The Description' / 'Elegant Clothing Links' then '/ The Personal Stylist Guide / www.classyladyacademy.com' over FULL creator clips; then like/comment ask 7:09-7:15 ('A simple like or comment would truly mean the world to us. Let us know what videos you'd like to see next.') over fashion clips without text; no subscribe ask.

ENDING (Q9): 7:16-7:20 'Until next time, bye, my loves.' over a film clip of a woman walking away into the night; 3.9 s dissolve to a white card with the centred tan CA / Classy Academy logo 7:21-7:59 (38 s). Music swells louder with no voice 7:21-7:24, fades by 7:25.5, then pure silence to the end.

CARAMEL BREATH BEATS: almost every change of block passes through ~1 s of empty blurred caramel (0:26, 0:32, 1:34, 1:39, 1:47, 1:55, 3:51, 4:08, 5:05, 5:20, 6:08, 6:19, 6:40) or empty cream (0:49, 3:00, 3:07, 4:21, 4:26, 5:12, 6:26).
BACKGROUND SWAP UNDER A CLIP: the background behind a centred clip dissolves from cream to caramel while the clip stays (Diana 1:52-1:53; bar clip 6:29-6:30).
GROW FROM SMALL: centred clips sometimes scale up from a small box in ~0.5 s (2:37 panel talk; 5:35 blonde vlogger; Audrey row 0:27-0:29).

TEXT TYPING SYNC: every quote/caption builds word by word exactly as the voice says it (e.g. 0:53-0:57; 2:52-2:59; 6:51-6:57). Quote cards keep the spoken grammar, with small typos left on screen ('Elegant woman don't rush' 5:07; 'Pause, breath' 6:20).

MIXED SOURCES INSIDE ONE POINT: point 4 (texting) is almost all stock-like clips of hands with phones plus bubble graphics; points 1-2 lean on classic films and royals; points 3 and 5 on modern talk-show/interview footage of celebrities.

AGE/DIVERSITY: older women appear on purpose inside otherwise young rows (silver-haired woman texting 3:54; Demi Moore-like 1:32, Monica Bellucci-like 5:17, Gwyneth Paltrow-like 5:50); Black women at 1:10, 1:35, 2:39, 3:39, 5:00; East Asian women at 1:18, 2:01, 2:43; a woman in hijab 3:28; a plus-size woman 6:13.

Q10: the video is 'Episode 14' of a series - the title card numbers the episode. The same creator in the polka-dot dress appears for the 'real life' example (5:14) and for the description call-out (6:58), so her footage frames the practical parts.
